snippet.title: C.U.B.E. | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
⭐ C.U.B.E is OUT NOW on Steam:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4523340/CUBE/

C.U.B.E is coming to Steam! Wishlist it now and prepare to face the Trials.

🖥️ Join The LovDev Community Discord! https://discord.gg/Y32KP3MH5F

C.U.B.E. is my upcoming 1-6 player co-op horror game where you must survive deadly Trials, work together, and keep your death count as low as possible.

After 10 days, the player with the fewest deaths is chosen as the True Subject. Everyone then enters the Final Evaluation, where the True Subject must face the rest.

If you like Lethal Company, R.E.P.O., PEAK, Content Warning, or other chaotic co-op games, you’ll feel right at home.

✨ Follow My Socials:
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/lovdevx
Twitter: https://x.com/lovlokx
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/lovlok/

─

Tags: #cube #coophorror #multiplayer #indiegame #steam #gaming #funny
